## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "GISTM Design Criteria"`

```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
.SITE <- .currentTarget("siteID.target")
.STEM <- paste0(tolower(.SITE), "-gistm")
.VARS <- list(
  Standard.target = "GISTM",
  ID.target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID.target = .SITE
)
.VARS <- .VARS[lengths(.VARS) > 0L]
```

:::{.panel-tabset .full-width}

### Criterios

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
NGR::knitBlock(
  path = "/_tbl/gistm.qmd",
  stem = .STEM,
  labels = "rewrite",
  vars = c(.VARS, list(
    CAP = readCaption("tbl.gistm.ES"),
    CONTENT = jsonlite::read_json(file.path(root, "_captions", "tbl.gistm.ES.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
  )),
  root = root
)
```

#| echo: false
